description1: We provide warranty and out-of-security services for safes, vault doors and locking systems. We perform diagnostics, repair and replacement of components in order to restore reliable operation and extend the operating life of the equipment.
description2: We perform professional installation and replacement of mechanical and electronic locks for safes and vault facilities. We consider choosing a locking mechanism with the construction of equipment and security requirements.
description3: We offer recode and setup of mechanical and electronic code locks. The service allows changing access combinations when changing the responsible persons, doubting a compromised code or need to update security.
description4: Regular prevention is important for reliable and seamless operation of locking mechanisms. We perform technical inspection, verification of functionality and necessary settings to prevent malfunctions and premature wear.
description5: In case of blocked mechanism, lost key or problem with the locking system we offer professional assistance to restore access to safes and vault facilities. We approach each case individually by seeking to limit possible damage to equipment.
description6: We assist in the selection of safes, vault doors and specialized equipment according to purpose, installation conditions and the required level of protection. We help you find the right solution in line with the specific requirements of your site.
